tools.name: search_linkedin_job_signals
tools.description: Search LinkedIn for new job postings from the target accounts that indicate hiring signals over a given time window.

tools.name: retrieve_linkedin_job_detail
tools.description: Retrieve the full detail of a specific LinkedIn job posting, including role, department, and posting metadata.

tools.name: lookup_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Look up the LinkedIn profile of the decision maker associated with a hiring signal to identify the right contact.

tools.name: query_existing_salesforce_records
tools.description: Query Salesforce for existing leads, contacts, and accounts matching the target accounts to detect duplicates before creating anything.

tools.name: draft_lead_and_signal_batch
tools.description: Assemble a draft batch of proposed new leads, proposed Hiring Signals sheet rows, and a proposed #new-signals summary message, for the user to review and approve.

tools.name: create_salesforce_lead
tools.description: Create a new lead record in Salesforce for a decision maker.

tools.name: update_salesforce_lead
tools.description: Update an existing Salesforce lead record's fields or status.

tools.name: append_hiring_signals_row
tools.description: Append a new row to the Hiring Signals tracking sheet recording a logged signal.

tools.name: post_slack_channel_summary
tools.description: Post a signal summary message to the #new-signals Slack channel, visible to all channel members.

tools.name: read_prospecting_playbook
tools.description: Read the SDR prospecting playbook covering lead qualification criteria and signal-logging conventions.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their metadata to locate the correct destination channel.

tools.name: lookup_sales_team_directory
tools.description: Look up sales team members, their roles, and lead ownership assignments.
